name: Compact six science packs · left in / right out · 60/min
setupNotes: Six packs at 60/min target. All material entrances on the left; all six collection chests on the right. Finished green/red circuits, engines, processing units, LDS, frames, furnaces and productivity module 1s are external inputs. Iron and steel each have two labeled entrances. No fluids, bots, installed modules or quality bonuses. Keep red wires and stock controls. Factorio 2.1.24 flight-save recipes.
Input rates are recipe demand at exactly 60/min each, excluding startup stock. Supply surplus when running above target.
